package.name: arm_language
package.description:
Language front-end (task 3.1): free-form text to a validated, guardrailed manipulation command. The backend is swappable (architecture D5) — cloud Claude by default, an offline keyword matcher for CI and lab-less development.
Note the cloud backend needs the `anthropic` pip package, which is deliberately NOT declared below: it has no rosdep key, so declaring it would break `rosdep install` for everyone including CI. The package builds, lints, and passes its whole test suite without it; only calling the cloud backend needs `pip install anthropic`.
